reason: The hypothesis cites no prior evidence, and its key premises—such as the existence of a Cr/Al-rich oxide on equiatomic CoCrFeMnNi, its mechanical removal under wear, and the specific balance controlling tribo-corrosion—are specific claims requiring experimental support that is not provided.
premises: CoCrFeMnNi forms a protective Cr/Al-rich passive oxide film
Sliding wear mechanically removes this oxide film
Repassivation kinetics can be slower than mechanical removal
Localized corrosion accelerates when oxide is absent
Total degradation is governed by the balance of oxide removal and repassivation
